text: After nearly a year of caution, the $\textbf{U.S.}$ $\textbf{Federal}$ $\textbf{Reserve}$ delivered its $\textbf{second}$ $\textbf{post-crisis}$ $\textbf{interest}$ $\textbf{rate}$ $\textbf{hike}$ in $\textbf{December}$ $\textbf{2016}$.
